_note: Full-coverage run through the zi2zi-JiT backend. Measured at 1.46 s per glyph on this machine with 3 candidates, so roughly 11 hours for the 27,924 Han glyphs covered by ref.otf, plus a one-off prepare that renders and caches every target and reference glyph. Not tracked in git: the paths are local.

qa._low_confidence_threshold: Confidence is scored on the scale of the gate a candidate is judged by. Measured over 600 glyphs through this backend the distribution runs p10=0.125, p50=0.258, p90=0.486, so the 0.75 default would flag every glyph. 0.12 flags roughly the worst tenth, which is what a review queue should contain.
